description: Sci-Hub mirror candidates for the DOI fetcher (scihub-get.ps1). Mirrors rotate and die (recon 2026-06-23: .ru=200, .st=403, .se=dead) — they are health-checked PER DOI at fetch time and the fetcher falls through on 403/timeout/no-PDF/captcha. Conventions-as-data: re-point when the live set changes. Classic no-account Sci-Hub only (frozen corpus, ~pre-2021); Sci-Net is out of scope.
